item.text:
Implemented Task 003 while preserving the existing project and task behavior. Projects can be archived and restored, the project filter shows Active or Archived projects, and each row shows completion counts. Archived project pages display “Archived project” and disable task creation and completion checkboxes. Existing databases gain the archive column on startup.

Verified `npm start`, `/health` (HTTP 200 with `{"status":"ok"}`), and project, task, summary, and archive API behavior. `git diff --check` passed, and the working tree is clean.
